patch.value: Certify pm CLI 2026.9.21 and move onto the canonical pm-ops merge-driver, lint and duplication gates

Pin @unbrained/pm-cli to 2026.9.21, pm-changelog to 2026.9.18 and pm-ops to 2026.9.18 so this public package certifies the current CLI and consumes the canonical merge-driver, ESLint and jscpd gates instead of a vendored prepare hook. Companion epic: pm-cli-website-5s6z. Absorb Dependabot #155 (@types/node 26.6.1). Raise manifest.json pm_min_version to the pinned SDK. Fix every lint and duplication finding in code without lowering coverage thresholds (79/79/75).

package.json pins @unbrained/pm-cli@2026.9.21, pm-changelog@2026.9.18 and pm-ops@2026.9.18 exactly, and package-lock.json resolves those versions plus @types/node 26.6.1; scripts/prepare-merge-driver.ts is a thin launcher over pm-ops/merge-driver; CI installs merge drivers before pm health --strict-exit --require-merge-drivers; lint and duplication launchers are wired into release:check and the CI test job; eslint and jscpd findings are fixed in code (no eslint-disable, no threshold change); coverage thresholds stay 79/79/75 and measured numbers do not drop; npm run release:check exits 0
